The <b>Horn Fragment</b> is a [[Items (Silksong)#Deliverables|deliverable item]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
The Horn Fragment must be delivered to [[Bellhart]] to complete the <i>[[Savage Beastfly (Wish)|Savage Beastfly]]</i> Grand Hunt Wish, available from its [[Wishwalls|Wishwall]] after defeating the original [[Savage Beastfly]] in [[Hunter's March]], having discovered [[Songclave]], and after defeating [[Fourth Chorus]] (the last one is optional in [[Act 3]]).

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Frey 01.png!Location in Bellhart
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Frey 01.png!Wishwall in Bellhart
}}

== How to Acquire ==
The Horn Fragment is dropped after slaying the [[Savage Beastfly]] in [[Far Fields]], which only appears while the wish <i>Savage Beastfly</i> is in progress.

If Hornet dies after the Savage Beastfly is killed, the Horn Fragment can be found on the floor of the arena upon reentering the room.

|Image1 = Mapshot SS Savage Beastfly 02.png!Location in Far Fields
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Savage Beastfly 06.png!Savage Beastfly in Far Fields
}}
